title: spring.memcached
description: Two buckets: spring.memcached.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.memcached.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.memcached.

default.description: Family-wide values, each overridable by an instance.

driver.description: Names the Driver bean that assembles every instance's transport unless an instance names its own. Empty injects the single Driver bean by type; naming a missing bean fails startup.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

scheme.description: Narrows discovery to endpoints of one transport scheme (e.g. tls, https). Empty returns every scheme. Only used with service-name.
